name: CloseWindow

parameters.name: #Window
parameters.description: The window to close. If #PB_All is specified, all the remaining windows are closed.

remarks:
All remaining opened windows are automatically closed when the program ends.

Note: The following items created for a window are also automatically freed when the window
is closed: Gadgets, Keyboard shortcuts,
Menus, StatusBars, Timers,
Toolbars and binded events (with BindEvent()).
